tips..rail-collapse[aria-label='Hide conversa: Fold the chat list to a thin strip. Bring it back with the strip, or from Panels.
tips..rail-collapse[aria-label='Hide details': Fold the details panel to a thin strip. Bring it back with the strip, or from Panels.
tips..rail-expand[aria-label='Show details']: Show the details panel: Inspect, Warnings and Why.
tips..session-filter select, .rail-left selec: Choose which chats are listed, how they are sorted, and how they are grouped.
tips..fp-toggle: Fold or unfold this failure: what happened, why, and what to do next.
tips..fp-nav button: Step to the previous or next failure in this chat.
tips..fp-body button: Select this step on the map and open it in Inspect.
tips..event-timeline summary: The recorded timeline: every event in order, with its recording time. Click one to select it.
tips..why button, .why summary: Explain why this run failed, read from its recorded failures.
tips..us-sources button: Read the token counters again from the selected sources.
tips..us-source-main: Count this harness or Spark lane in Usage. Off by default; nothing is read until you switch it on.
tips..ps-reset: Put this preset's panels back to their defaults. Your chat and filters stay.
tips..ps-preset: Switch how much interface you see. Nothing is deleted; every panel stays listed here.
tips..ps-switch: Show or hide this panel. Hidden panels stay listed here.
tips..replay-bar input[type='range']: Drag to replay the chat up to any step. Nothing is re-run.
tips..asof: The newest recorded event in this view. If this stops advancing while the agent works, the recorder or the stream has stalled.

items.name: Live badge
items.what: Whether the page is connected to the viewer and how long ago the last event arrived.

items.name: Telemetry
items.what: The build (click to copy it for a bug report), the number of loaded events, and lost records the recorder had to skip. Shown in Standard and Everything; turn it on in any preset from Panels.

items.name: Follow Newest
items.what: Jump to whichever chat is working right now and keep its newest step in view.

items.name: All Chats / This Chat Only
items.what: Show the list of every recorded chat, or only the one you are reading.

items.name: Reset view (↺)
items.what: Put view, zoom, filters and panels back the way Omniscience first opens. Recordings are never touched.

items.name: Maximize (⛶)
items.what: Full screen; Esc leaves.

items.name: Mini Panel
items.what: A small frame on the right with only what you chose to watch.

items.name: Panels
items.what: Show, hide and resize every panel, switch between Simple, Standard and Everything, and reset the layout.

items.name: Settings (⚙)
items.what: Default view, compact text, chat titles, the theme (dark or Paper), recording and privacy.

items.name: Help
items.what: What Am I Looking At? explains every box and colour; Take the Tour walks five stops in about 30 seconds.

items.name: List · Map · Time · Tokens · Usage
items.what: The five main views. More Views adds Flame, Tools, Context, Helpers, Coverage and Latency.

items.name: Filters
items.what: Hide tool steps, hide model calls, or show errors only. The number on the button counts filters that are on.

items.name: Writeup
items.what: The diagnosis Hermes wrote for this recording (tokens, timings, rate limits, context growth, what to fix). Run /omni insight in Hermes to write a fresh one; the viewer reads the saved report and never calls a model itself.

items.name: Actions
items.what: Export CSV (timings, tokens, models, never message text), open Panels, or reset the view.

items.name: Verdict
items.what: One sentence: OK, Delays, Failing or Running, with where the time went (model, tools, waiting).

items.name: Summary line
items.what: Always visible: how the chat ended, model calls, tools and failures. Click it to open the Briefing.

items.name: Briefing
items.what: The plain-English chat summary, each failure with why and what to do, the activity summary, the recorded timeline and the summary bar. Stays open or closed as you left it.

items.name: Failure stepper
items.what: ‹ and › step through this chat's failures and select each one on the map.

items.name: Lost records
items.what: Shown when the recorder had to skip events; conclusions about this chat may be incomplete.

items.name: Tokens per call
items.what: How much context each model call re-sent: spikes show where it piled up, drops show compactions. On by default; not repeated on Tokens and Context, which are already that chart.

items.name: Fold (–)
items.what: Fold a panel to its title bar; + unfolds it. Remembered.

items.name: Double height (↕)
items.what: Give a panel twice the room, or put it back.

items.name: Hide (×)
items.what: Hide a panel. It stays listed in Panels, where one click brings it back.

items.name: Focus (⤢)
items.what: Lift one panel over the page, full height, with its notes. Esc leaves.

items.name: Resize bar
items.what: Drag a panel's bottom edge, or focus it and use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps, Home and End for the limits). Remembered per panel.

items.name: Inspect
items.what: The selected step's timing, tokens and data; with nothing selected, the longest steps. Selecting a step opens this tab.

items.name: Warnings
items.what: Patterns worth a look in this chat, grouped by kind with a count. Select one to highlight it on the map.

items.name: Why
items.what: Why the run failed, read from its recorded failures.

items.name: Simple
items.what: One thing at a time: the map, the status band and the token chart. Chat list and details fold to the edges. The default.

items.name: Standard
items.what: Chat list, map and the details panel side by side, with the telemetry in the header.

items.name: Everything
items.what: Every panel open, including the Briefing, the map key and the telemetry.

items.name: First-run tour
items.what: New visitors are offered a five-stop tour: pick a chat, the status line, tokens per call, the map, and Panels. Not Now dismisses it for good; Help → Take the Tour runs it any time, and so does adding ?tour=1 to the address.

items.name: Tooltips
items.what: Hover any control, or reach it with the keyboard, to see what it does.
